n=20
G=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
pts=[(2,6),(3,19),(4,5),(7,1),(8,19),(12,9),(17,13),(19,15)]
for r,c in pts:G[r][c]=1
r0,r1,c0,c1=2,8,9,15
for r in range(r0,r1+1):
    for c in range(c0,c1+1): G[r][c]=2
# horizontal line extensions
for r in range(r0,r1+1):
    left=any(G[r][c]==1 for c in range(c0))
    right=any(G[r][c]==1 for c in range(c1+1,n))
    if not left and not right: ranges=[(0,c0-1),(c1+1,n-1)]
    elif left and not right: ranges=[(c1+1,n-1)]
    elif right and not left: ranges=[(0,c0-1)]
    else: ranges=[]
    for a,b in ranges:
        for c in range(a,b+1):
            if G[r][c]==0:G[r][c]=2
# vertical line extensions
for c in range(c0,c1+1):
    top=any(G[r][c]==1 for r in range(r0))
    bottom=any(G[r][c]==1 for r in range(r1+1,n))
    if not top and not bottom: ranges=[(0,r0-1),(r1+1,n-1)]
    elif top and not bottom: ranges=[(r1+1,n-1)]
    elif bottom and not top: ranges=[(0,r0-1)]
    else: ranges=[]
    for a,b in ranges:
        for r in range(a,b+1):
            if G[r][c]==0:G[r][c]=2
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in G))
